FOR SALE 5 BEDROOM VILLA , LYSOS, POLIS €695,000 FULL TITTLE DEEDS This MAGNIFICENT 5 BEDROOM COUNTRY RETREAT is situated in a completely private location on the borders of Lysos, some 15 minutes drive from Polis. TITLE DEEDS, FULLY FURNISHED. The word magnificent is sometimes used as overkill by estate agents – but not in this case. Built on a plot of over 8,000m2 it offers stunning mountain views along a valley which can never be obstructed. For those wanting for total seclusion look no further than this amazing villa. The nearest property can be seen but it is a long way in the distance Built to the current owner's design and specification it has 5 bedrooms, 3 of which are en suite, wonderfully high wood- beamed ceilings and imposing stone finished pillars. What’s more, the property benefits from insulation meaning warmer in the winter and cooler in the summer. The property lies 5 minutes’ drive from a very quiet road, and the villa is approached through a quiet road leading to a driveway large to accommodate many, many cars. The porch is guarded by pillars either side of the door and once through the front door is a welcoming entrance hall. From the entrance hall, the lounge and diner can be seen at their most impressive. The kitchen is to the right of the front door with the dining area next to it, thus allowing air to circulate through the whole of this area. The well equipped kitchen has top quality features including black granite worktops, a breakfast bar /island with storage space, LG fridge/freezer, ARISTON double oven, BOEMBERG dishwasher, a 5 ring gas hob, and a wine cooler. Added to this is a double sink and the quality of these white goods is self-evident. All of these goods are included in the selling price. To allow for more room for the essential kitchen task of cooking, there is a utility room which has an LG washing machine and a sink. The dining area includes a dining table large enough to easily accommodate 6 people and 8 top quality leather dining chairs. 4 marble steps lead to the superbly equipped lounge. Outstanding features of the lounge include a laminated wood effect floor and a 50” flat screen PANASONIC TV which has multi channel including access to movies and box sets and high speed internet. If this isn’t impressive enough there is an authentic log burner complete with electric fan which kicks in when the temperature reaches a certain level and is housed by a stunning stone finished chimney breast. Another outstanding feature is the wooden cathedral ceiling.. Patio doors lead to the south facing covered patio offering shade in the summer and sun in the winter. Two of the five bedrooms are on the ground floor. All are doubles and the first of these is south facing offering the outstanding views across the valley, patio doors to the veranda and has a very modern en-suite shower room. The second ground floor bedroom is currently being used as an office, and has a very large window offering equally impressive views over the surrounding countryside. A guest cloakroom completes the rooms on the ground floor. A majestic sweeping marble staircase leads to the first floor. The 3 remaining bedrooms are on this floor. The master bedroom is breath-taking in its splendor. Not only does it have a large dressing area complete with plenty of wardrobe,space, but also an en suite bathroom including a very generously sized rectangular marble finished bath with separate shower and heated towel rail. Add the leather finished super king sized bed and the private balcony offering stunning mountain views and the splendour of this bedroom becomes apparent. Bedroom 2 is also en suite with a separate shower cubicle, has its own balcony and again offers stunning mountain views. The final bedroom is north facing and, as is the case with all rooms offers stunning views. A very modern shower room completes the rooms on the first floor. If the interior of this property is not impressive enough then the outside is simply stunning. The attractive pool measures 15m x 6m and has a highly original beach feature. This means that the approach to the pool has simulated sand which gives the impression of walking into the water from a beach – most unusual! There is underwater lighting which is coloured LED lights and has a choice of programmes and it is also worth mentioning that the pool is solar heated. In addition attractive rockery surrounds the pool and running water cascades over the rockery into the pool giving a simply delightful effect. The villa has been built in the middle of the plot so it is ideal for those wishing to follow the sun. One final point: there is an outside w.c for the use of anyone who doesn’t want to go back inside the villa in the middle of sun worshiping!! There is also a large store room which is accessed externally. We should also highlight the intelligent and innovative positioning and size of the windows which allow as much sunshine in as possible making the atmosphere increasingly light and airy.
